title: AgendaItem
description: One numbered piece of business at a meeting.

@id.description: This agenda item's own dereferenceable identifier.

@type.description: Always `AgendaItem` - minted as a subclass of `schema:ListItem`, which already supplies ordering.

name.description: The item's short title as it appears on the agenda, e.g. 'Approval of minutes'.

description.description: A longer plain-language summary of the item, when the name alone isn't enough.

position.description: Order on the agenda. `schema:position` ranges over `Integer` or `Text`, and real agenda numbering is frequently alphanumeric - '3.', 'A.', '2a.' - so a string is valid. Use the publisher's own agenda number where one exists; fall back to an ordinal only when it does not.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this item beyond its `@id`.

about.description: The `Legislation` under consideration, where the item concerns one - the hinge between the meetings profile and the code profile, so a law's passage can be traced to the sitting that passed it and the vote that carried it.

result.description: What the body decided. Absent means not yet decided.

voteEvent.description: Votes taken on this item. More than one is normal: an amendment, then the main motion.

attachment.description: Supporting documents for this item - a staff report, a proposed ordinance's text.

isPartOf.description: The `Meeting`, when the item is published standalone.
